value.html: {{company.name}} (“we”, “us”, “our”) operates Jubarte, a macOS application that compares Microsoft Word documents and produces tracked-changes redlines, and this website, jubarte.pro. This policy explains what we do and don’t collect.

source: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use on jubarte.pro, last updated 2026-10-02

value.heading: Documents stay on your device
value.html: Jubarte compares your documents locally, on your Mac. The contents of the documents you open are never uploaded to us or to any third party, and we never see them.

source: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use on jubarte.pro, last updated 2026-10-02

value.heading: Subscription data
value.html: Jubarte {{app_store.version}}, on the Mac App Store today, is a one-time purchase. From its next release, Jubarte offers an auto-renewable subscription sold through the Apple App Store. Apple processes all payments — we never receive your payment card details or your Apple Account credentials. To verify and manage your subscription, our verification service receives from Apple a cryptographically-signed transaction record containing subscription identifiers only: transaction ID, original transaction ID, product identifier, purchase and expiration dates, and the environment (sandbox or production). We store this entitlement state to confirm your access. Apple also sends our verification service signed App Store Server Notifications when a subscription renews, lapses, enters a billing grace period, is cancelled or is refunded; we use them only to update that same record (its expiration, grace-period and refund dates, and whether it renews automatically). This record does not contain your name, email address, or any document content.

source: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use on jubarte.pro, last updated 2026-10-02

value.heading: No tracking or advertising
value.html: Jubarte contains no third-party advertising, no advertising identifiers, and no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs.

source: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use on jubarte.pro, last updated 2026-10-02

value.heading: This website
value.html:
• The demo and the app preview run in your browser. Documents you drop on the Demo or App pages are read and compared by WebAssembly inside your browser tab. They are not uploaded to us or anyone else, and they are gone when you close the tab.
  • Request limits. Cloudflare serves this site. To keep it available, our worker counts page requests per IP address and answers more than {{site.limit_per_minute}} in a minute with a “slow down” page; the count is kept by Cloudflare for that minute only. Cloudflare’s request logs (time, page, status and similar metadata) are kept for a few days for troubleshooting.
  • No cookies, no analytics. The site sets no cookies and loads no analytics, advertising or third-party scripts. Its fonts and scripts are served from jubarte.pro.
  • Links elsewhere. Benchmark files link to Hugging Face, source code to GitHub, and the app to the Mac App Store. When you follow those links, those services’ own privacy policies apply.
  • Contact form. The contact form only drafts an email in your own mail app. We receive what you choose to send.

source: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use on jubarte.pro, last updated 2026-10-02

value.heading: Service providers

value.heading: Services you reach through us
value.html:
Jubarte’s downloads and files live with these services. You deal with them directly when you follow a link to them. They may count downloads, but they send us nothing about you.

  • Hugging Face, Inc. — hosts the benchmark documents and their results. Privacy policy · Terms
  • The Rust Foundation (crates.io) — hosts the engine as a Rust crate. Privacy policy · Terms
  • The Python Software Foundation (PyPI) — hosts the engine’s Python wheels. Privacy policy · Terms
  • npm, Inc. (npm) — hosts the engine’s WebAssembly package. Privacy policy · Terms

Their documents govern what each provider does with your information; this policy governs what we do with it.

Jubarte turns comparing two Word documents into a five-second task.

Drop in an original and a revised .docx file, and Jubarte builds a fully tracked-changes redline that opens cleanly in Microsoft Word — insertions underlined, deletions struck through, moves flagged — exactly the way legal, editorial, and business teams expect a redline to look.

Why Jubarte

Comparing contract drafts, policy revisions, or manuscript edits by eye is slow and error-prone. Word's built-in "Compare Documents" feature works, but it's buried in menus, inconsistent across versions, and often produces redlines cluttered with formatting noise instead of real content changes. Jubarte does one thing and does it well: give you a clean, accurate, Word-native redline, fast.

How it works

1. Drop your original document and your modified document into Jubarte.
2. Click "Create redline."
3. Get a real .docx file with proper Word tracked-changes formatting — insertions, deletions, and moved text all clearly marked — ready to open in Word, share with colleagues, or send out for review.

Built for real documents

Jubarte is built on a dedicated OOXML engine designed specifically for Word's document format, so redlines preserve your original formatting, styles, and structure instead of mangling them. A legend and change counts are shown right in the app so you know exactly what changed — how many insertions, how many deletions — before you even open Word.

Made for professionals who live in Word

Whether you're a lawyer redlining a contract, an editor tracking manuscript revisions, or a business analyst comparing policy drafts, Jubarte gives you a native Word redline without any of the manual comparison work.

Privacy first

Your documents are processed entirely on your Mac. Nothing is uploaded to a server, nothing leaves your machine. Jubarte works completely offline.

What you get

- Instant Word-native tracked-changes redlines
- Clean handling of insertions, deletions, and moved text
- Change counts and a visual legend before you open the file
- Works entirely offline — your documents never leave your Mac
- Native macOS app built for speed
